name: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80 Steel Blue
description: An iconic 1978 design revived for the modern era, featuring an integrated stainless steel bracelet and waffle blue dial. Powered by the Powermatic 80 automatic movement with an 80-hour power reserve and scratch-resistant sapphire crystal.

name: Hugo Boss Grand Prix Chronograph
description: Inspired by precision motorsports, this chronograph features a high-grade brushed steel casing and jet-black sunray dial. Complete with triple sub-dials, date aperture, and a perforated perforated racing leather strap.

name: Rado Centrix Diamond Rose Gold
description: The Rado Centrix embodies timeless glamour with its lightweight tapered high-tech ceramic and rose-gold PVD bracelet. Four genuine diamond hour markers sparkle against the deep black lacquer dial.

name: Emporio Armani Renato Minimalist Black
description: Clean Italian architectural lines meet modern sophistication in this monochrome black timepiece. Fitted with an ultra-slim matte stainless steel case, subtle eagle logo index, and supple genuine Italian leather band.

name: Seiko 5 Sports Automatic Navy Sunburst
description: Legendary Japanese reliability boasting the Caliber 4R36 automatic movement with manual winding capability. Designed with a deep navy unidirectional rotating bezel, luminous LumiBrite hands, and 100m water resistance.

name: Versace Medusa Icon Square Gold
description: Unapologetically bold Haute Horlogerie accented with the unmistakable Versace Greca geometric engraving. The radiant 3D Medusa head sits prominently at 12 o'clock surrounded by an exquisite champagne guilloché dial.

name: Citizen Eco-Drive Vintage Tank Silver
description: Powered by any light source and never needing a battery change, Citizen Eco-Drive merges sustainable tech with vintage art-deco elegance. Features a curved rectangular case, blued hands, and textured silver railway track dial.

name: Casio Edifice Solar Chronograph Emerald
description: A high-performance motorsports watch crafted with an emerald green dial and solar charging mechanism. Engineered with a 1-second stopwatch, solid steel link bracelet, and scratch-resistant sapphire glass crystal.

name: Tissot Gentleman Titanium Royal Blue
description: Exceptionally lightweight and hypoallergenic, the Tissot Gentleman Titanium offers effortless daily elegance. Its striking royal blue dial catches the light beneath double anti-reflective sapphire crystal.

name: Hugo Boss Pilot Stealth Chrono
description: An aviation-inspired masterpiece cloaked in stealth matte gunmetal IP plating. Equipped with tachymeter scale bezel, high-contrast luminescent indexes, and an ultra-durable silicone hybrid strap.

name: Fossil Carlie Mother-of-Pearl Rose Gold
description: Flawless feminine styling featuring a natural iridescent mother-of-pearl dial framed by pavé crystal accents. The refined T-bar lug attachment flows seamlessly into a slender rose-gold mesh band.

name: Tommy Hilfiger Baker Burgundy Leather
description: Signature East Coast prep aesthetic highlighted by a rich burgundy sunray dial and polished rose gold accents. Accompanied by a top-stitched mahogany calfskin strap with embossed Hilfiger crest.

name: Citizen Stiletto Ultra-Thin Mesh
description: At less than 5mm in profile, the Citizen Stiletto is among the slimmest solar-powered timepieces ever constructed. Pure minimalist silver dial with sleek baton markers and surgical grade stainless mesh.

name: Seiko Presage Cocktail Time Havana Brown
description: Inspired by the glamorous ambiance of bespoke cocktail bars, featuring an intricately stamped radial guilloché pattern. Driven by the revered 4R35 mechanical caliber visible through the exhibition case back.

name: Versace V-Twist Turquoise Ladies Watch
description: An opulent fusion of luxury jewelry and Swiss watchmaking craft. Boasting a vivid turquoise dial framed by yellow gold ionic plating and a rotating decorative bezel ring.

name: Rado Coupole Classic Automatic Gold
description: Distinguished Swiss luxury timepiece with distinctive vintage dome sapphire crystal and gold PVD case. Housing an automatic movement offering 80 hours of power reserve with anti-magnetic Nivachron balance spring.

name: Rado True Square White Ceramic
description: Sculpted from monobloc high-tech ceramic in pristine pure white with gold accents. Incredibly comfortable, temperature-adapting, and virtually impossible to scratch over a lifetime of wear.

name: Casio Edifice Slim Sapphire Anthracite
description: Engineered with a streamlined 8.3mm profile, anthracite octagonal bezel, and brushed stainless steel construction. Sapphire crystal ensures maximum clarity while defending against everyday micro-scratches.

name: Fossil Jacqueline Petite Blush Rose
description: Delicate Roman numerals and a petite 32mm dial make this the ultimate everyday companion. Features a soft blush pink leather band and a shimmering satin finish rose-gold dial.

name: Seiko Prospex Speedtimer Chronograph
description: A tribute to the world's first automatic chronograph from 1969. Solar powered V192 movement charges from any light, complemented by a sandblasted dial finish, 24-hour sub-dial, and curved sapphire.

name: Ray-Ban Round Metal Classic Gold
description: Iconic counter-culture round silhouette with delicate gold wire frame and crystal G-15 green lenses. Offers complete UV400 protection and lightweight adjustable nose pads for all-day comfort.

name: Tom Ford Snowdon Vintage Havana Optical
description: Distinguished thick-rim acetate frames in rich Italian dark havana tortoise shell. Embellished with the signature Tom Ford metal 'T' temples and ready for custom prescription or blue-light lenses.

name: Ray-Ban Aviator Classic Polarized G-15
description: Originally engineered in 1937 for US aviators, the iconic pilot teardrop shape remains the gold standard of luxury eyewear. Features polarized anti-glare lenses and durable tubular gold temples.

name: Prada Runway Cat-Eye Geometric Black
description: Avant-garde haute couture design with thick beveled acetate edges and an upward feline sweep. Adorned with the lettered Prada Milano handbag insignia in high-polish gold along both temples.

name: Gucci Round Metal Optical Rose Gold
description: Refined Italian luxury eyewear in polished rose gold with interlocking GG emblems along the wire stems. Superb lightweight frame engineered for both fashion and prescription lens compatibility.

name: Oakley Holbrook Prizm Black Polarized
description: Timeless American frame design fused with Oakley's cutting-edge Prizm lens technology for hyper-vivid color contrast. Built from lightweight, impact-resistant O-Matter stress-resistant frame material.

name: Persol 649 Series Steve McQueen Pilot
description: Handmade in Lauriano, Italy since 1957 with the patented Meflecto flexible stem system and signature silver Supreme Arrow. Deep cobalt havana tones with premium crystal tempered sun lenses.

name: Ray-Ban Clubmaster Clear Blue Light
description: The quintessential browline frame updated with contemporary transparent crystal acetate and silver hardware. Fitted with blue-light filter lenses to minimize digital eye strain from phones and screens.

name: Versace Medusa Glam Burgundy Cat-Eye
description: Dramatic cat-eye architecture drenched in rich burgundy jewel tones and accented with open-work gold Medusa medallions. Features gradient UV-resistant polycarbonate lenses for high glamour.

name: Carrera 1001/S Pilot Aviator Tortoise
description: Born on the racetrack, these bold oversized pilot sunglasses feature the recognizable Carrera 'C' logo front and center. Warm gradient brown lenses complement the lightweight optyl acetate body.

name: Tom Ford Geometric Hexagon Gold Frame
description: Sculptural polygon silhouette crafted from ultra-thin Japanese titanium with rose-gold flash. Adjustable ceramic nose pads deliver balanced weight distribution and enduring luxury finish.

name: Gucci Web Stripe Round Olive Acetate
description: Distinctive translucent olive green Italian acetate frames featuring the iconic red-and-green Gucci Web enamel stripe on the temples. A standout optical frame ready for fashion or vision wear.

name: Oakley Frogskins Classic Matte Black
description: A celebrated 80s heritage style engineered with modern High Definition Optics (HDO) and Plutonite lenses that block 100% of UVA, UVB, and UVC. Matte black frames with tonal Oakley wordmark.

name: Ray-Ban Justin Matte Black Gradient Blue
description: Inspired by the classic Wayfarer, Justin offers a slightly larger rectangular frame with a luxurious rubberized soft-touch matte finish. Blue mirror gradient lenses provide crisp optical clarity.

name: Prada Cinéma Havana Butterfly Frames
description: Graceful oversized butterfly frames blending warm speckled havana acetate with pale gold metallic brow bars. Soft brown gradient lenses offer 100% UV filtration and pure cinematic appeal.
